steps.body: A strategy is not just a shortcut — it works because it respects what addition and subtraction actually mean. Explaining why keeps that connection visible.

widget.prompt: Check: does hopping ten from 43 agree with adding ten the mental way?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 43 and count on 10: you land on 53.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 53 — the hop matches the mental ten-more strategy exactly.

predict.prompt: A strategy gives a different answer than counting one at a time would. Is it a valid strategy?

options.label: Yes — strategies can differ from counting

predict.reveal: Any valid strategy must agree with counting one at a time — that is what makes it trustworthy.

widget.prompt: 8 + 7 = ? Which value makes this equation true?

options.feedback: Correct — 8 + 7 is 15, so 15 is the value that makes the statement true.
Check by adding again: 8 + 7 is 15, not this value.
That overshoots the actual sum of 8 and 7, which is 15.
That is the DIFFERENCE between 8 and 7, not their sum.
